title: The Little Bird Who Needed Help
synopsis: Beth tries to hang a leaf curtain, asks Mama Bird to steady one side, and completes the job.

related_resources.reason: Caregiver strategies for frustration; not evidence that grit or solitary persistence always works.
Age-adapted play, flexible plans and scaffolding; does not empirically evaluate these particular story manuscripts.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: Beth rested there for a minute.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: A pause can make room to reconsider a difficult plan.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: General caregiver coaching advice; the bird situation is invented.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: She didn't take the leaf and finish everything herself.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: A grown-up can assist without taking every decision away.
Practical cooperation can make a task with two simultaneous parts feasible.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: Editorial example, not a research intervention.

source_note: The manuscript is original fictional narrative. Citations apply only to stated parent-facing developmental rationales; they do not source plots or establish an effect from listening to this story.
